place_fields.vibe: Seasonal Western Ghats waterfall near the Karnataka-Goa border
place_fields.summary: Kalasa Falls, also referred to as Kanakumbhi in visitor sources, is a seasonal waterfall in the Surla-Kanakumbi area near the Karnataka-Goa border. The supplied coordinates are preserved exactly.

planning_attributes.description: Visitor sources describe Kalasa Falls as a monsoon waterfall reached by a short nature trek in the Surla area; map data places Kalasa Falls near Kanakumbi and Parwad.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Map and visitor sources place the falls in the Surla-Kanakumbi area near Parwad and Chorla; a short nature trek is described from the surrounding access area.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The site involves natural terrain and trekking; caution is appropriate on wet and uneven ground during the monsoon.

place_fields.micro_region: Sundi village, Chandgad taluk, Kolhapur district, Maharashtra
place_fields.vibe: Seasonal monsoon waterfall in a rural Western Ghats landscape
place_fields.summary: Sundi Waterfall is a seasonal waterfall near Sundi village in Chandgad taluk, Kolhapur district, Maharashtra, close to the Karnataka border. Visitor sources describe a short approach through agricultural fields to the waterfall.

planning_attributes.description: Recent visitor reporting describes Sundi Waterfall as a seasonal monsoon attraction near Sundi village, with a short walk from roadside parking through fields followed by a descent to the waterfall.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: A local travel source reports a fall of about 50 feet; this is retained as an approximate reported height rather than an independently verified measurement.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Visitor sources place the falls near Sundi village in Chandgad taluk; the final approach is described as a short walk through fields from roadside parking, followed by steps or a rocky descent.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Current reporting is inconsistent: a July 2026 report says Sundi Falls remained prohibited under district orders, while recent local visitor reporting describes ticketed access. Current local authority status should therefore be checked before travel.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Sources describe uneven or difficult rocky terrain near the falls; monsoon water levels and slippery surfaces can increase risk, so visitors should use caution and avoid unsafe water-edge areas.
